map.按固定成本、单位变动成本、单价与预计销量测算边际贡献、保本销量和预计利润，并对比: Measure contribution margin, break-even volume and expected profit from fixed cost, unit variable cost, price and expected sales, and compare the profit lift from a lower unit variable cost.
map.单位边际贡献 = 单价 − 单位变动成本；边际贡献率 = 单位边际贡献 ÷ 单价: Unit contribution margin = price − unit variable cost; contribution margin ratio = unit contribution margin ÷ price × 100%; break-even volume = fixed cost ÷ unit contribution margin; expected profit = unit contribution margin × expected sales − fixed cost; optimized profit = (price − optimized unit variable cost) × expected sales − fixed cost.
map.本量利（CVP）测算：输入固定成本、单位变动成本、单价、预计销量与优化后单位变动: CVP analysis: enter fixed cost, unit variable cost, price, expected sales and the optimized unit variable cost to compute contribution margin, break-even volume, expected profit and the profit lift from cost reduction, supporting pricing, cost control and cost-reduction decisions.
map.单价 ≤ 单位变动成本，任何销量均亏损，无保本点。: Price ≤ unit variable cost: every sales level loses money, so no break-even point exists.
map.请填写有效的非负成本、正单价、非负销量与优化后成本。: Enter valid non-negative costs, a positive price, non-negative sales and an optimized cost.
map.注：未计税费与多产品组合；固定成本含推广、人力等不随销量变化的费用。结果仅供参考: Note: taxes and multi-product mixes are excluded; fixed costs include promotion, labour and other costs that do not vary with volume. Results are for reference only; actual financial accounting prevails.
map.定价前测算保本销量：固定成本 60,000 元、单价 50 元、单位变动成本 3: Estimate break-even volume before pricing: with fixed cost 60,000 CNY, price 50 CNY and unit variable cost 30 CNY, break-even volume is 3,000 units.
map.对比降本方案：单位变动成本从 30 降到 26，保本销量由 3,000 降到 2: Compare cost-reduction plans: cutting the unit variable cost from 30 to 26 lowers break-even volume from 3,000 to 2,500 units.
map.按预计销量估算利润，判断当前定价与成本结构是否可行。: Estimate profit at the expected sales level to judge whether the current pricing and cost structure work.
map.固定成本 60,000、单位变动成本 30、单价 50、预计销量 5,000、优: Fixed cost 60,000, unit variable cost 30, price 50, expected sales 5,000, optimized unit variable cost 26. Unit contribution margin 20 CNY, contribution margin ratio 40%, break-even volume 60,000÷20 = 3,000 units, break-even sales 150,000 CNY; expected profit 20×5,000 − 60,000 = 40,000 CNY. With the optimized unit contribution margin of 24 CNY, profit is 24×5,000 − 60,000 = 60,000 CNY, a lift of 20,000 CNY, and break-even volume falls to 2,500 units.
map.保本点怎么算？: How is the break-even point computed?
map.保本销量 = 固定成本 ÷（单价 − 单位变动成本）；单价小于等于单位变动成本时: Break-even volume = fixed cost ÷ (price − unit variable cost). When price is at or below unit variable cost the unit contribution margin is not positive, so no sales level breaks even and the page reports "no break-even point".
map.边际贡献率是什么？: What is the contribution margin ratio?
map.单位边际贡献 ÷ 单价 ×100%，表示每 1 元销售额中可用于覆盖固定成本并形: Unit contribution margin ÷ price × 100%, the share of each 1 CNY of sales available to cover fixed cost and generate profit; with the default inputs it is 20÷50 = 40%.
map.降本后的利润提升怎么算？: How is the profit lift from cost reduction computed?
map.两个方案分别按“（单价 − 单位变动成本）× 预计销量 − 固定成本”计算利润，: Profit for each plan is (price − unit variable cost) × expected sales − fixed cost, and the difference is the lift; with the default inputs it is 60,000 − 40,000 = 20,000 CNY.
map.单位边际贡献 × 销量 − 固定成本: Unit contribution margin × volume − fixed cost
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据不会上传到服务器: The tool runs entirely in the front end; data is never uploaded to a server.
map.建议在主流浏览器（Chrome/Safari/Firefox/Edge）中使用: Use a mainstream browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge).
map.按固定成本、单位变动成本、单价与预计销量做本量利测算；单价 ≤ 单位变动成本时无: CVP estimation from fixed cost, unit variable cost, price and expected sales; when price ≤ unit variable cost there is no break-even point. Results are arithmetic estimates excluding taxes and multi-product mixes.
